proof_body:
by
  intro R P _ _ _
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := Module.projective_def'.1 h
    exact ⟨s, Finsupp.linearCombination R id, hs⟩
  · rintro ⟨i, s, h⟩
    exact Module.Projective.of_split i s h
target_source: ∀ (R P : Type*) [Ring R] [AddCommGroup P] [Module R P], Module.Projective R P ↔ ∃ (i : P →ₗ[R] (P →₀ R)) (s : (P →₀ R) →ₗ[R] P), s.comp i = LinearMap.id
